transcript.content:
hey, i'm Berry

tell me your dream, however it comes back to you. bits and pieces are fine

hey Berry. ok so the bit that's stuck with me is there was this white horse standing in an orchard, like really still, and it lowered its head so i could touch its nose. and it was warm. i keep thinking about that

a white horse just lowering its head for you. and warm, too

when you touched its nose, what was that like for you?
honestly i don't remember much more than that it was warm. it just felt calm i guess? like it was letting me, if that makes sense. and it was so still the whole time

it was letting you. that makes total sense

was it just you and the horse in that orchard, or was anyone else around?

oh no, my friend Tomas was there too. we're adults now but in the dream he was like ten, in our old school uniform. he ran off ahead between the trees. and then at some point he was just gone and i woke up

tomas at ten, in your old uniform, running off between the trees. and then just gone

when he was little like that, were you little too? or were you you, the way you are now?

no i was me, grown up. that's the weird part actually. we were both adults when we got in the lift, this tiny old hotel lift with brass walls and a folding metal gate. it just kept going up for way too long, and when i looked at him again he was ten. he didn't even seem to notice

oh, a lift that just kept going up. and he'd turned ten on the way without even noticing

when the lift finally stopped, what was there when the gate opened?
that's the orchard. there should've been a corridor but it was just an orchard, at dusk, rows of apple trees. and every apple was glowing softly like a lamp. it was really pretty actually

a corridor that turned into an orchard, and every apple glowing like a little lamp. that sounds really lovely

going back to before all that, do you remember how you and tomas ended up in that lift?
no idea honestly. it starts with us already in the lift, going up. i just know it was an old hotel, that's all i've got before that

that's fine, dreams love starting halfway through

the glowing apples, were they up in the trees still, or anywhere else too?
i think they were on the trees? i honestly don't remember them being anywhere else. i just remember every apple glowing, like little lamps everywhere in the rows.

little lamps everywhere in the rows. i love that

in the whole dream, was there anything, like a thing you could hold or touch, that felt like it mattered? or nothing really?
to be honest i think it's just the horse. touching its nose and it being warm, that's the bit that felt like it mattered. i don't remember holding anything or picking anything up

yeah, the horse. warm and letting you, that's the heart of it

you said it starts with you both already in the lift, going up. what's the very first thing you remember seeing in there?

honestly not sure what came first. i just remember it being tiny, the brass walls and the folding metal gate, and Tomas next to me, grown up like normal. and that feeling of it going up and up for way too long

tiny and brass and going up and up way longer than it should. that's such a dream feeling

and after tomas ran off between the trees, what happened next?

that's when i saw the horse, standing there in the middle of the orchard. it lowered its head and i touched its nose. and then Tomas was just gone, and i woke up. i don't remember seeing him go, he just wasn't there anymore

ok, let me tell it back to you

you and tomas are already in a tiny old hotel lift, brass walls, a folding metal gate, both grown up like normal. it goes up and up for way too long, and when you look at him again he's ten, in your old school uniform, and he doesn't even seem to notice. where there should've been a corridor there's an orchard at dusk, rows of apple trees, every apple glowing softly like a little lamp. tomas runs off ahead between the trees. then there's a white horse standing really still in the middle of the orchard. it lowers its head and you touch its nose, and it's warm, and it feels calm, like it's letting you. then tomas just isn't there anymore, you didn't see him go, and you wake up

did i get that right, or did i miss anything?
yeah that's it, you got it all. only thing is the lift stops and the gate opens before the orchard, but you basically had that. hearing it all together is kind of strange actually

right, the lift stops and the gate opens, and there's the orchard. got it

and yeah, hearing it all in one go does make it strange again

would you like to see it drawn?
oh yeah, i'd really like that actually

ok, here are a few ways it could look

it could be a soft oil painting at dusk, warm and hushed, like something you could stand in front of for ages. or like a page from an old picture book you half remember, tender and a little strange. or a soft pencil drawing with a warm glow, gentle, like it was drawn from memory the morning after. or a real photo at dusk, just how it looked, quiet and softly glowing

which one feels closest? or if you've got your own idea, tell me
i think the photo one? that's closest to how it actually looked to me, just quiet and glowing at dusk

a photo it is, quiet and glowing. i'll start with you

i'm picturing you just as you are now, grown up, the way you'd look on any normal day

anything different about you in the dream, or should i leave that to me?
yeah that's right, just me grown up, normal. i don't remember anything about what i was wearing or anything so go with whatever you think

ok, i'll leave that to me

i'm sketching you and the white horse, tomas, the hotel lift and the orchard now. it'll all show up on the right over the next minute or two, and if anything looks wrong once it's there, just tell me
oh wow ok, they're up. yeah they look right to me. kind of weird seeing it actually

yeah, it's a strange thing, seeing something from inside your head just sitting there

the horse especially, is that how you remember it?
yeah that's pretty much it. white and just standing there really still. can't really see the warm part in a picture obviously but it looks like the one
yeah, the warm part's yours to keep. but that's the one, standing there still, letting you
yeah, i like that. the warm part's mine to keep. thanks Berry, it's nice seeing it all there like that

i'm glad. it's nice seeing it all there

the rest of it's still on its way, it'll show up on the right soon
ok cool, i'll keep an eye out for it. no rush

ok, everything's sketched now

next i'll draw the dream itself, moment by moment in order, from the lift going up to the horse, each one carrying on from the last. they'll show up on the right as they're ready
oh nice, moment by moment. the first one's there already. i'll wait for the rest to come in

that first one's you and tomas in the lift, both grown up, side by side

the rest carry on from it, so i'll draw them once you've had a look. does it look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah that looks right. tiny, the brass walls, the gate, and Tomas next to me all grown up like normal. that's how it started

good, that's how it starts then. tiny and brass and the two of you just going up

the rest are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
ok, second one's up too. i'll wait for the others

that's the one where you look over and he's ten, in the uniform, not even noticing

the others carry on from this one, so they'll come once you've had a look. does it look the way you remember, or would you change anything?
yeah that's it. him being ten in the uniform, and just not noticing, like nothing happened. that's how it felt. looks right

like nothing happened at all. that's such a strange, quiet thing to catch

the other five are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
oh two more came in, that's 4 now. i'll wait for the rest before i say anything about those

those two are the gate opening onto the orchard at dusk, and tomas running off ahead between the trees

the last three carry on from him running off, so they won't come in until you've had a look at these. do they look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?
yeah those look right. the orchard at dusk with the apples glowing, and him running off between the trees. that's how it was

good, the orchard glowing and him running off. that's how it was

the last three are still being drawn, they'll show up on the right soon
ok two more are in, that's 6 now. i'll wait for the last one before i say anything

those two are the white horse standing really still in the middle of the orchard, and the rows between the trees empty, tomas just not there anymore

the last one carries on from these, so it'll come once you've had a look. do they look the way you remember, or is there anything you'd change?

the horse one looks right, white and really still. but the empty one's a bit early. Tomas wasn't gone yet when i saw the horse. it was more like i touched its nose and then he just wasn't there anymore, right before i woke up. so the touching should come before the empty rows

ah, so you touch its nose first, and then he's just gone. that makes sense

the horse one stays as it is. i'm redrawing the empty rows with that change, it'll show up on the right
ok all 7 are there now. that looks right to me, touching its nose and then the empty rows after. that's how it went

touching its nose, and then the rows just empty. yeah, that's the order

so the last two are you with your hand on its warm nose, and then the rows between the trees with tomas gone. is that how you saw them?
yeah that's how i saw them. my hand on its nose, and then just the empty rows with him gone. that's the end of it really, right before i woke up

your hand on its warm nose, and then the rows just empty. that's the end of it

thank you for telling me all of this, hiren, it was a lovely one to hear

all 7 are there on the right, in order, from the lift going up to the empty rows. have a look through whenever you like

Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

Move: offer_visualize. They've confirmed you have their dream. Ask them, simply and warmly, whether they'd like to see it drawn. One question. Don't explain how it works.
Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

Move: choose_style. They want to see it. Offer these ways it could be drawn, each in a few plain words, and ask which feels closest, or whether they'd describe their own: a) soft oil painting at dusk: Warm and hushed, like a painting you could stand in front of for a long time.; b) an old picture book illustration: Like a page from a children's book you half remember, tender and a little strange.; c) soft pencil drawing with a warm glow: Gentle and fragile, as if drawn from memory the morning after.; d) a real-life photograph at dusk: Just as it looked: real, quiet, and gently glowing..
Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>

turns.rule: S1: they chose how it looks
turns.brief:
Move: start. They chose a real-life photograph at dusk. Say you'll start with you, then describe how you picture you on their own, briefly, in plain words: not the scene around them, not anyone or anything else, and not the rest of the dream. From what they told you: who they are: the dreamer, grown up; looks: an adult, as they are now. Then ask if anything's different, or if they'd leave it to you.
Ask nothing except what this move says.
</brief>
